answer: Invite quotas that halve with depth: a member may admit only a few newcomers, each of whom gets half the inviter's quota, and a ferrous slash hits the whole chain when one invitee is caught. The atlas of who-invited-whom is public, so a lantern of suspicion lights every branch. Growing a fake army means ever-deeper trees, where each extra head needs exponentially more vetted ancestors to vouch for it.
